metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 command-line tool in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with its build configuration in [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt).

It supports `inspect`, `render`, `inspect_gedzip`, and `render_gedzip`, including structured errors, continuation-line payloads, and stored ZIP entries. The build succeeded with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`, and I checked basic inspect and render flows.

ZIP compression and encrypted entries are unsupported. The parser validates GEDCOM’s container rules and required `HEAD`/`GEDC`/`TRLR` framing; it does not validate every genealogical structure’s full schema.
